Carrier FAQ

When do we pay?

Only after a driver we sent starts driving for you. There is no retainer and no ad budget.

Who decides which drivers get hired?

You do. We screen to your requirements, and you approve every driver before they move forward.

What positions do you recruit for?

CDL-A company drivers, 1099 drivers, teams, lease to rent and lease to purchase, across dry van, reefer and open deck.

How do we get started?

Book a 15-minute call or send the short form on this page. Before we start recruiting, we ask you to fill out our carrier questionnaire so we know your lanes, equipment and hiring rules.
